title: [AINews] The No AI Slop Manifesto
author: swyx .ai
description: November 13, 2026 — AIE speakers unite to lay out how to fight slop.
summary: Congrats to both llama.ccp and ggml for reaching 1.0 (declaring stability and removing 35 deprecated functions from llama.cpp’s public header) and with SGLang also announcing 1.0 at the recent SGLang Summit . However, today’s title story goes to the No AI Slop manifesto , which arose out of the conference discussions at AIE CODE and which Dex introduced in the closing keynote after cosignatures by many of the speaker
